comment: Files that animate but carry no entry in TRANSITIONS.md or CANVAS-WIDGETS.md. A motion is on this list because it is state feedback local to one control, not a designed piece of the site's motion language. Anything a reader could want to find, reuse or coordinate with belongs in a document instead.

allowed.src/components/NewsletterSubscribe.astro: submit-state feedback local to the form
allowed.src/components/SpeakingEnquiry.astro: submit-state feedback local to the form
allowed.src/components/VideoLoader.astro: loading shimmer while a poster resolves
allowed.src/shared/Theme.ts: frame-timed class swap on the theme toggle, no designed motion
